_doc: Body geometry and actuation limits shared by all backends (SI). Sources: robot radius/dribbler/ball from ssl-unification src/Env/Env.h (ROBOT_RADIUS 90 mm, ROBOT_CENTER_TO_DRIBBLER 75 mm, BALL_RADIUS 22 mm, MAX_ANGLE_DIFF_WITH_BALL_ATTACHED_IN_DRIBBLER 0.31 rad, MAX_FLAT_KICK_SPEED 6.5, MAX_CHIP_KICK_SPEED 6.0); v_max/w_max from config/ssl_robot.sldd (sat_v, sat_w). The published behavioral plant has NO saturation/acceleration limit; a_max=null keeps it that way.

deadzone._doc: Firmware per-wheel deadzone (config/robot_geometry.json firmware.motor_min_speed_rad_s). OFF by default: the published twin is linear.
